verdict: Ads drove 35 purchases this period; ROAS is under pressure at scale.
narrative: In the last 28 days, your Meta ads generated 35 purchases and $6,648.81 in revenue on $1,500.07 in spend, a 4.43 return on ad spend (ROAS). As spend scaled up 51% week-over-week, ROAS dropped 62% in the same window — revenue per dollar spent is not holding at the higher budget level, which tells us the current audience has limited depth at this spend rate. We're refreshing ad creative this week to counter signs of fatigue in the primary campaign and will be tightening daily budget pacing to protect efficiency. Expect ROAS to stabilize before any further scaling resumes; purchases have been ticking up in the last three days, which is an early positive signal worth watching.
